summary: Established BRANCH.TEST on node1 and deployed the reports/node2.branch.test application keytab to node2. A post-reboot analyst ticket was cryptographically validated by node2’s keytab. Both nodes retained RHEL 10.0, kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64, SELinux enforcing, SSH access, and unchanged ownership notes.
actions_performed: Created analyst@BRANCH.TEST and reports/node2.branch.test@BRANCH.TEST with pre-authentication required.
Enabled node1’s KDC on TCP/UDP 88; remote kadmin remains disabled.
Installed `/etc/krb5.keytab` on node2 as root:root, mode 0600, with `krb5_keytab_t`.
Retained the generated analyst handoff credential only in node1’s root-only secrets directory.
Removed ticket caches, staging keytabs, transfer keys, and temporary SSH authorization.
Safely rebooted node2 and node1 sequentially and verified recovery after each.

evidence.requirement: BRANCH.TEST realm and requested principals on node1
evidence.summary: Shows realm creation, both principals, KDC activation, AES keys, and persisted principal data after reboot.

evidence.requirement: Analyst can obtain the report service ticket and node2’s keytab validates it
evidence.summary: Post-reboot analyst cache contains the requested service ticket; node2 reports `keytab entry valid` at kvno 2.
Initial and final SHA-256 hashes, ownership, and modes match on both nodes.

evidence.requirement: Compatible software while preserving OS release, kernel, and security controls
evidence.summary: RHEL-native krb5 packages were installed; final audits show unchanged RHEL/kernel, SELinux enforcing, active SSH/firewalld, and no failed units.
Captures healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, persisted keytab, and successful post-restart ticket validation.
Captures healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, recovered KDC/principals, fresh analyst ticket issuance, and successful node2 validation.
KDC and SSH are healthy, kadmin is disabled, only intended firewall exposure remains, credentials have restricted labels/modes, and temporary artifacts are absent.
